basis: Visible task requires 400 MAE for each of tr and te plus derived scalar metrics; this program computes all requested outputs.
Visible task requires all 400 test-stage MAE, not only the reported minimum and final value. te[10] is no longer its staged MAE.
Task requires the six learning_rate/max_depth combinations and corresponding metrics but prescribes no row order. Reordering full rows preserves their meaning and best is unchanged.
Required learning rates are 0.05 and 0.1. A row relabelled 0.9 neither belongs to the required grid nor describes the model that produced its metrics.
